description: Plugin hooks: block WebFetch against client-rendered hosts (YouTube, Reddit) and steer to a tool that works; refuse a SerpApi call made outside commands/serpapi/search.py, which saves and reuses responses. The challenge-detector Stop hook is offline (see hooks/challenge-detector.py): a blocking Stop hook fires inside automated `claude -p` worker sessions and breaks them. Re-enable once it can gate to interactive sessions only.
